result.title: AffineGS: Unlocking Accurate Geometry in 3DGS via Spatially Varying Affine Rectification
result.comment: Accpeted to NeurIPS 2026. Project page: https://eldentse.github.io/AffineGS/
result.summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has become the leading approach for photorealistic novel view synthesis, yet its geometric accuracy lags behind its visual quality. Existing depth-guided methods attempt to resolve this by regularizing the optimization with monocular depth priors, typically using a single global scale-and-shift alignment. Crucially, we discover a fundamental flaw in this assumption: modern monocular depth networks systematically exhibit region-dependent, piecewise-linear distortions. This discovery invalidates standard global alignment strategies, which warp scene geometry by enforcing a single transform. To address this, we introduce a spatially varying affine rectification model that corrects monocular disparity into consistent metric depth using regionally smooth, edge-aware fields. We further derive a normal-aware regularizer that uses spatial gradients to couple the rectified disparity with 3DGS depth and normals. Across diverse experimental settings, our sensor-free method shows strong photometric quality of Gaussian Splatting while substantially improving geometric accuracy and outperforming state-of-the art geometry-focused methods.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文指出现有单目深度先验的全局尺度-平移对齐假设存在区域相关的分段线性畸变缺陷，并提出空间变化仿射校正场及法向感知正则项，以提升 3DGS 的几何精度。
